`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0) begin : fast256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_selected;
        wire [15:0] local_selected [0:15];
        wire [15:0] low_terms [0:3];
        wire [15:0] high_terms [0:3];
        genvar g, j, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            assign x = input_unencoded[16*g +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;

            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g];
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] &
                                           ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : top_position
                    assign local_selected[g][j] = x[j];
                end else begin : other_position
                    assign local_selected[g][j] = x[j] & ~(|x[15:j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_position
                    // Includes both a bit-zero winner and the all-zero input.
                    assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);
                end else begin : nonzero_position
                    assign output_unencoded[16*g+j] =
                        group_selected[g] & local_selected[g][j];
                end
            end

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_group
                wire [15:0] local_terms;
                for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : encode_position
                    if ((j & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                        assign local_terms[j] = local_selected[g][j];
                    end else begin : excluded
                        assign local_terms[j] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                assign low_terms[b][g] = group_selected[g] & (|local_terms);
                if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : high_included
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = group_selected[g];
                end else begin : high_excluded
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_output
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
            assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_terms[b];
        end
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : original_parameters
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The supplied mapped paths support targeting the priority-selection-to-one-hot-output cone. All three start at input_unencoded[174], share logic through a buf_12, and then traverse a mux2i_4 and an o2111a_4 before final decoding gates. Those two cells alone contribute about 1.05 ns of the reported 2.60 ns. The source computes an encoded winner and then shifts a constant to produce the one-hot output, making late encoded selection and decode distribution plausible bottlenecks. The reports do not establish an exact RTL-to-cell correspondence or identify arithmetic carry chains.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-bit one-hot winners and group highest-valid winners in parallel using suffix reductions. Generate one-hot outputs directly by qualifying each local winner with its group winner, rather than decoding the final encoded bus. Form encoded low bits from group-qualified local encodings and high bits from the selected group. Implement output_unencoded[0] directly as the absence of any set bit above bit zero, preserving its special invalid-input value. Other parameter settings retain the original implementation.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Hypothesis, not a measurement: removing the encoded-bus-to-256-way-decode dependency should shorten the reported one-hot paths. A reasonable evaluation target is a 10–25% reduction from 2.60 ns, approximately 1.95–2.34 ns maximum arrival. The low encoded-bit reduction paths or group-selection fanout could instead become limiting. Only the prescribed mapping and OpenSTA run can establish whether any improvement occurs.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The candidate removes the final variable-shift decoder but adds explicit local winner logic, group qualification, and encoded reduction networks. Sharing local suffix reductions and keeping group fanout localized are intended to control area; no mapped area is available, so compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap is not established. ABC can change sharing and buffering substantially. Acceptance requires full equivalence, mapped area at or below the cap, and zero max-slew and max-capacitance violations under the supplied flow; none of those tool checks has been performed here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, every nonzero binary input selects its highest set index, asserts output_valid, and produces matching encoded and one-hot outputs. For all-zero input, all selected-group terms vanish, yielding output_valid=0 and output_encoded=0, while the explicit bit-zero equation yields output_unencoded=256'b1. No invalid outputs are masked or treated as don't-cares. The module name, ports, widths, original parameter names and defaults are retained. The implementation is purely combinational, with no clocks, state, input restrictions, or assumptions. Formal proof must compare every output bit over all binary inputs for the fixed instance."
}
